text:
Jason Robertson's name is in the trade columns. Yahoo Sports reported an insider floating a Robertson for Nikita Kucherov blockbuster, and NHL Trade Rumors ran an analyst calling it "Difficult To Imagine" that he signs long term in Dallas. The Stars, per Yahoo, want to extend him.

Meanwhile he keeps producing: 22 points in 20 games, seven goals in his last ten including a hat trick against Washington. Dallas takes 54.4% of the expected goals at five on five with him on. Evolving-Hockey had him 14th among 401 forwards in wins above replacement last season, with play-driving in the 98th percentile.

Some of it will fade. The Stars have scored 5.4 more goals than the chances deserve with him on the ice, which is padding his assists, and his ice time is down 1:45 a night over his last ten. His own shooting is less of a concern: 10 goals on 7.8 expected, shooting 15% against a range centred near 14%. What to watch is whether the noise around him turns into anything. On the ice, he's given Dallas no reason to want less of him.
headline: Robertson is scoring while his future gets argued over
